shared_elements: incised or carved linear figures on a stone surface (as depicted forms, i.e. outlined bodies with limbs)
justification: The only real correspondence is that both surfaces show creature-like forms rendered in strict profile with limbs indicated by lines; nothing more specific is shared. B depicts a highly detailed anthropomorphic winged, bird-headed figure holding a bucket and raising a cone, flanked by elaborate rosette-flower plants beneath a band of dense inscription, whereas A shows only crude, schematic pecked animal/abstract outlines with no attributes, no wings, no vegetal border and no ordered framing scheme.
